entry.title: When AI Stops Feeling Magical: Greg Hochmuth

media:group.media:title: When AI Stops Feeling Magical: Greg Hochmuth
media:group.media:description:
#ai #generativeai #design
Episode 5 of Dream Logic features our first guest, Greg Hochmuth, who describes the seductive, infinite flow of AI-generated imagery, and what happens when it stops feeling magical. As both an artist and creative technologist, he brings a rare perspective on the immersive pull of the medium, the exhaustion that follows, and the moment when mystery gives way to math.
Please share with the curious.
Created by Kirby Ferguson and Karin Fyrhie.

entry.title: Wrestling with Originality: Dream Logic Episode 3

media:group.media:title: Wrestling with Originality: Dream Logic Episode 3
media:group.media:description:
#ai #generativeai #design
In this episode, Karin talks about how working with AI feels like a wrestling match, a constant push and pull, a struggle to coax something fresh and original out of a system that wants to create the common.
In this new episode of Dream Logic, we explore what this metaphorical grappling with generative AI feels like, how to build characters through hyper collage, and what we can really call our own when it comes to art.
Please share with the curious.
Created by Kirby Ferguson and Karin Fyrhie.

entry.title: Imagination Isn't Algorithmic: Dream Logic Episode 2

media:group.media:title: Imagination Isn't Algorithmic: Dream Logic Episode 2
media:group.media:description:
#ai #generativeai #design Dream Logic: Exploring the horizons of creative work
In this episode, Kirby explores the strange, dreamlike world of AI-generated art and how it reflects the human imagination, while lacking its creative spark. These tools may feel powerful and even awe-inspiring, but creativity remains an irreducible mystery. The genie of AI is here to challenge, not replace, what makes us truly human.
Dream Logic is something different from me. A collaboration with my pal Karin Fyhrie, an attempt to do something different and hopefully beautiful in collaboration with AI. media:group.media:description:
Dream Logic: Exploring the horizons of creative work
This is something different from me. A collaboration with my pal Karin Fyhrie, an attempt to do something different and hopefully beautiful in collaboration with AI. It’s the start of a weekly conversation: musings, artist interviews, and long looks into the strange, evolving landscape of new creative tools.
In this episode, Karin reflects on the unexpected freedoms and failures of this medium, and what she's noticed among peers in the design world. What it makes possible. What it doesn’t. It’s an open invitation to think differently.
